items.title: Will Shade and Dewey Corley Interview, 1960-05-25
items.q: I've got his address now, but I ain't seen him in about, oh, three or four, four, five years or longer.

ctx.x: He's a good guitar player. He made a couple of records too here a long time ago. I've got his address now, but I ain't seen him in about, oh, three or four, four, five years or longer. Because here about four or five months ago he comes through here.
Well, we're about to run out of time. I'm afraid we better cut it off. But I sure do thank you all a million for...
